title: Codex adapter
description: Concrete-first openai x cli bridge: spawn codex exec --json, parse JSONL into codex-specific events, classify errors (limit/transport/terminal). Proven by a real integration test. No shared type yet.

title: Claude Code adapter
description: anthropic x cli bridge. Verified claude 2.1.195: spawn claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose, parse JSONL into the richest event set of the three (real text/thinking/tool_use + cache-token usage + cost). Success gated on result.is_error===false (subtype lies); skips hook noise. Mirrors codex; 3rd classifyError consumer.

title: Antigravity (agy) adapter
description: google x cli bridge. Verified agy 1.0.13: --print is plain-text only (no JSON/usage/events), so the codex-shaped event type is mostly stubbed with a documented Python-SDK sidecar upgrade path. Mirrors codex; reuses classifyError.

title: Normalized WorkerEvent stream
description: One typed, CLI-agnostic event shape (reasoning, tool-call/result, file-change, log, usage) across all adapters.

title: Error classification (limit/transport vs terminal)
description: Each adapter classifies failures so the later fallback layer has a signal. No fallback logic in the adapter itself.

title: Step-function state-machine panel
description: The permanent live panel: each step shows Success/Failed/Cancelled/In-Progress. Doubles as every layer's proof.

title: Observability
description: Parse the full event stream (tool calls, logs, decisions) and render it into the panel.

title: Verification gate
description: Lint/test/judge must pass before a run can claim done; a fake done turns the step red.

title: Guardrails & caps
description: Sandbox modes, step/token caps, wall-clock timeout, cancel.

title: Soul library (roles as data)
description: developer/reviewer/qa souls: role + responsibilities + methodology, stored as data.

title: Verified instruction-channel injection
description: Render a soul into each CLI's instruction channel (e.g. codex -c override vs temp AGENTS.md); confirm per CLI.

title: Role picker
description: Pick the soul a task runs under; same task + different soul = visibly different behavior.

title: Plugin catalog
description: Register third-party packs (e.g. extensions-factory/superpowers) into a browsable catalog.

title: Install into CLIs
description: End-user clicks Install; the pack is installed into codex/claude/agy so the agent can use it.

title: Per-task harness gating
description: The harness denies installed tools/plugins to tasks that don't need them — installed is not always-on (least privilege).

title: Delivery state machine
description: Native states (groom/spec/plan/build/review/verify/ship) wrapping the subsystems into one run.

title: Phase delegation to souls
description: Each phase runs on a Worker wearing the right soul; mandatory review/verify gates before ship.

title: Idea to delivery run (= MVP)
description: An idea runs end-to-end through the step-function panel and returns real output — the MVP bar.

title: Agent CRUD
description: Create/edit/list/delete agents (Company x Protocol x AuthMethod x model).

title: Auth flows
description: Per-AuthMethod onboarding: apiKey, oauth2, oauth2Pkce, deviceCode, and CLI-login reference.

title: Secret storage + provider sidebar
description: Secrets in VSCode SecretStorage (CLI logins referenced, not copied); the Tree-based provider sidebar lists agents + live status.

title: Tool CRUD
description: Create/edit/list/delete the native tools Workers can call.

title: Per-worker enable/disable
description: Choose which tools each Worker/soul may use; feeds the harness per-task gate.

title: Plugin CRUD
description: Manage catalog entries for third-party packs (add/edit/remove).

title: Install / uninstall into CLIs
description: Install and remove plugin packs across codex/claude/agy from the management UI.

title: Enable / disable
description: Turn installed plugins on/off per Worker; feeds the harness per-task gate.

title: Soul CRUD
description: Create/edit/list/delete souls beyond the shipped library.

title: Role to soul mapping
description: Map orchestrator roles (PM/Architect/Developer/Reviewer/QA) to chosen souls.

title: Per-account config dirs
description: Isolated config dirs (CODEX_HOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / HOME) so one Company can host several agents.

title: OAuth / PKCE / device flows
description: Browser PKCE, token paste, and device-code flows per account.

title: Tier tagging
description: Tag each agent fast/balanced/deep; phases/souls declare a requiredTier.

title: Round-robin among peers
description: Spread load and rate limits across same-tier agents in round-robin order.

title: Automated fallback (resolves Decision A)
description: On a transport/limit failure, advance to remaining peers then the next-lower tier — the automated form of P1, deferred from the adapters by Decision A.

title: Durable run store
description: Persist Run objects (node, status, history, artifacts) to workspace storage.

title: Resume after restart
description: Rehydrate a run after a VSCode restart and continue from the last node; re-surface any pending decision.
